Em vez de esvaziarem o tanque, os aquaristas usam vácuos de sifão suaves para retirar resíduos, restos de comida e sujeira presa no cascalho.  Ao mesmo tempo, os sistemas de filtração purificam continuamente a água através da quebra de substâncias nocivas. Porque é que isto funciona tão bem 👇 ✔️ Peixes fiquem calmos (sem choque repentino) ✔️ Bactérias úteis permanecem vivas ✔️ A química da água permanece estável ✔️ O ciclo natural do nitrogênio continua Mudanças de água completas podem parecer limpas, mas podem realmente prejudicar os peixes. Cleaning a fish tank doesn't always mean draining it. In this method, waste and debris are removed while the water stays in place. Tools like siphon vacuums and filtration systems pull out uneaten food, algae, and sediment from the gravel, keeping the environment clean without stressing the fish. What makes this approach effective is balance. Beneficial bacteria remain undisturbed, water chemistry stays stable, and the tank continues to cycle naturally. It's a low-impact way to maintain a healthy aquarium, showing how smart maintenance can work with the ecosystem instead of resetting it. This video is for educational purposes only. How to do a water change🫧  This was the first water change after my betta moved in last week.  Step 1: unplug the heater, light, filter Step 2: siphon the substrate/ground Step 3: drain approx. 1/3 of the water  Step 4: dechlorinate the fresh water and fill up the aquarium Step 5: wipe the rim, edges, outside of the tank Step 6: feed your betta and show them some love.
